replies.author: ClickClickDrone
replies.text:
Aiwo

Have you uninstalled Sandboxed Google Play Services from your primary user?

If not, it means Play Services is still running in the background. I am pretty sure that's the case since you mention GmsCompat still emits status notifications.

replies.author: Aiwo
replies.text:
Thanks for the reply !

It is uninstalled already, and so is the Google Play Store, but GmsCompatConfig is installed.

Could it be responsible for the notification by itself or is there another app that I missed ?

replies.author: WelcomeMilk89
replies.text: Aiwo at one point were you using Google Play Store for apps? If so, you might want to open Play Store, go to your account and select that manage apps option. It can show you what apps might still be installed and using Google Play

replies.author: SinUsC
replies.text: What exactly does the notification say? When you tap on it, does it take you to the Exploit Protection settings? Do you have cross-profile notifications enabled? Do you have a sandboxed environment in your main profile?

replies.author: Aiwo
replies.text:
WelcomeMilk89

I have been, on my main profile before I split it all up. Now the apps on that profile are only updated through Accrescent, F-Droid or directly downloading an apk file. On my other profiles I am using the Google Play Store and those apps do appear in the menu you mention.

SinUsC

The notification says "GmsCompat - time // Sandboxed Google Play is running". No mention of it coming from another profile or anything. Cross-profile notifications are enabled but the only profile allowed to run in the background is my main one, so if I am on it the other profiles are not able to send me any notification.

I do not mean to have a sandboxed environment in my main profile but I guess I do if I get the notification. I am therefore trying to identify the source of this notification : WHO is using the Sandboxed Google Play ?
